_about: The characters anim_timing.py and vfx_sfx_build.py write into docs/rebuild/anim-timing.json and vfx-sfx.json, in output order. Any other character is passed on the command line (--char NAME --chr-b N [--prefix P]) and is not written here. sound_seqarc: the SDAT sequence archive whose sounds vfx-sfx.json renders for that character (absent: none; null: unknown).
